selected_experts.reason: Primary verification that the subject is indeed a daisy and not a look-alike (e.g., chamomile, aster) or AI-hallucinated hybrid.
To detect subtle texture anomalies, melting, or edge bleeding between the white petals and the green background, which are common AI artifacts in floral images.
To ensure the insect is structurally coherent and properly attached to the flower surface without fusion or floating artifacts.
To verify that the bokeh/blur in the background is geometrically consistent with a macro lens depth of field and not an AI-generated smear.

focus_areas: Texture consistency of the yellow disc florets (avoiding 'mushy' AI textures).
Edge sharpness between white petals and green background (checking for haloing/bleeding).
Structural integrity of the insect (legs, wings) to ensure it isn't a distorted blob.
Symmetry and natural variance of petal arrangement (AI often makes flowers too perfectly symmetrical or randomly chaotic).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the insect on the flower. AI generators often struggle with small, complex subjects like insects, resulting in melted legs or ambiguous anatomy. Also, scrutinize the transition between the yellow center and white petals for any color bleeding or unnatural gradients. Verify if the petal count and arrangement follow natural botanical patterns or show signs of algorithmic repetition/error.
